### `create_webhook`

**Create Webhook** · `POST /api/v2/team/{team_id}/webhook` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Set up a webhook to monitor for events.<br> We do not have a dedicated IP address for webhooks. We use our domain name and dynamic addressing.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_id` | path | number | yes | Workspace ID |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |
